sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Hollisk. Hollisk is an async Python web framework built on ASGI. Supported Python versions are 3.10 to 3.13. Set up with `hatch env create`, run tests with `hatch run test`, and run the linter with `hatch run lint`, which calls Ruff. Source lives in `src/hollisk/`; the request and response classes are in `src/hollisk/http.py`. Docs are built with MkDocs from the `docs/` folder by `hatch run docs:build`. Example apps live in `examples/`.

Contribution rules. Keep the core free of third-party runtime dependencies other than `anyio`. Middleware classes must implement `__call__(scope, receive, send)` and live in `src/hollisk/middleware/`. Test coverage for the core package must stay at or above 95 percent; CI enforces this. Do not change the public signature of `Hollisk.route` without an approved design note in `design/`. Each release is tagged `vX.Y.Z` and published to PyPI by the `release.yml` workflow. Commit messages follow the Conventional Commits format.

claims.text: The only third-party runtime dependency allowed in Hollisk's core is anyio.
The oldest Python version Hollisk supports is 3.9.
Hollisk's CI requires core test coverage of at least 95 percent.
Hollisk's request and response classes are in src/hollisk/http.py.
Hollisk releases are published to PyPI by the release.yml workflow.
